description.zh: 卡片短信发送ID。通过[SendCardSms](~~434120~~)接口或[SendBatchCardSms](~~434119~~)接口发送卡片短信时，获取返回值中的BizCardId字段。
description.en: The card SMS sending ID. When you send a card SMS by calling the [SendCardSms](~~434120~~) or [SendBatchCardSms](~~434119~~) operation, obtain the BizCardId field from the response.

description.zh: 数字短信发送ID，调用[SendCardSms](~~434120~~)接口或[SendBatchCardSms](~~434119~~)接口发送卡片短信时，获取返回值中的BizDigitalId字段。
description.en: The digital SMS sending ID. When you send a card SMS by calling the [SendCardSms](~~434120~~) or [SendBatchCardSms](~~434119~~) operation, obtain the BizDigitalId field from the response.

description.zh: 文本短信发送ID，调用[SendCardSms](~~434120~~)接口或[SendBatchCardSms](~~434119~~)接口发送卡片短信时，获取返回值中的BizSmsId字段。
description.en: The text SMS sending ID. When you send a card SMS by calling the [SendCardSms](~~434120~~) or [SendBatchCardSms](~~434119~~) operation, obtain the BizSmsId field from the response.

description.zh: 分页查看发送记录，指定发送记录的当前页码。
description.en: The current page number when you paginate sending records.

description.zh:
分页查看发送记录，指定每页显示的卡片短信记录数量。

取值范围为1~50。
description.en:
The number of card SMS records to display on each page when you paginate sending records.

Valid values: 1 to 50.

description.zh: 接收短信的国内手机号码。格式：11位手机号码，例如1390000****。
description.en: The domestic mobile phone number that received the SMS. Format: an 11-digit mobile phone number. For example, 1390000****.

description.zh:
卡片短信发送日期，支持查询最近30天的记录。

格式为yyyyMMdd，例如20240112。
description.en:
The card SMS sending date. Records from the last 30 days can be queried.

Format: yyyyMMdd. For example, 20240112.

title.zh: 查询单个号码的卡片短信发送记录和发送状态等信息
title.en: Queries the card SMS sending records and sending status of a single phone number
